To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the average household cost/cases was 30 times higher in the referral arm than in the community management arm of the trial, when the cost of antibiotics was included, and 30 times higher when the cost of the antibiotics was excluded.
household costs for treatment of severe pneumonia were significantly lower for community managed cases compared with hospital referred cases.
the average household cost/cases for a LHW (community) managed severe pneumonia case was 30 times lower than for referred cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the household costs for treatment of severe pneumonia in Pakistan.
the cost of severe pneumonia in Pakistan.
the household costs associated with the treatment of severe pneumonia in children under the age of five in Pakistan.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cost of treating severe pneumonia in Pakistan was 30 times more when referred to a hospital compared to community management.
the cost per case of pneumonia was 30 times less for community-based management of severe pneumonia with oral antibiotics than for referral to a hospital.
the cost of severe pneumonia management by LHWs is 30 times lower than the cost of referred cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
community based treatment with oral antibiotics for severe pneumonia in Pakistan is feasible and cost-effective, and could be implemented at scale.
community based treatment of severe pneumonia is a cost effective alternative to referral to hospital.
the cost of severe pneumonia care at the community level is much less than the hospital referral.
The main takeaway from our work is that
community management of severe pneumonia is feasible and cost-effective in low-resource settings.
oral antibiotics for severe pneumonia can be provided in the community, which can reduce the cost of treatment by 30 times.
community management of severe pneumonia with oral antibiotics is more affordable for households than referral to health facilities.
